items.exampleEn: Each new product goes through a careful evaluation.
items.exampleZh: 每項新產品都要經過仔細的評估。

items.exampleEn: There is more than one interpretation of this poem.
items.exampleZh: 這首詩有不只一種解讀。

items.exampleEn: I usually walk to work, but today was an exception.
items.exampleZh: 我平常走路上班，但今天是例外。

items.exampleEn: Have you thought about the implications of this decision?
items.exampleZh: 你想過這個決定可能帶來的影響嗎？

items.exampleEn: She received recognition for her years of hard work.
items.exampleZh: 她多年的努力獲得了肯定。

items.exampleEn: The guide assured us of a safe trip.
items.exampleZh: 導遊向我們保證旅途安全。

items.exampleEn: Don't make assumptions about people based on their clothes.
items.exampleZh: 不要只憑衣著就對別人下定論。

items.exampleEn: The two companies are in a dispute over the contract.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司因為合約起了糾紛。

items.sentenceEn: The two neighbors had a dispute about the noise at night.
items.sentenceZh: 兩位鄰居為了夜裡的噪音起了爭執。

items.audioEn: We assure all our customers that their personal information is safe.
items.audioZh: 我們向所有顧客保證，他們的個人資料很安全。
options: Prices will go down next month
The store opens early every day

items.sentenceEn: The rule applies to everyone; there are no exceptions.
items.sentenceZh: 這條規定適用於每個人，沒有例外。

items.sentenceEn: Your interpretation of the data is different from mine.
items.sentenceZh: 你對這些數據的解讀和我不同。

items.stemEn: He made the ____ that the meeting was canceled, but it was only moved to Friday.
items.stemZh: 他以為會議取消了，但其實只是改到星期五。

items.stemEn: The pilot ____ the passengers that there was nothing to worry about.
items.stemZh: 機長向乘客保證沒什麼好擔心的。

items.passageEn: Every year, our company gives an award to one worker in recognition of excellent service. This year, the evaluation was tough, because many people did well. At first, the team made the assumption that the sales manager would win, but the award went to a cleaner named Mr. Lu, who had worked here for twenty years. There was a small dispute about the decision, since the award had always gone to office staff, with no exceptions. However, the director explained her interpretation of excellent service: it means helping others every day. She assured everyone that the decision was fair. The implication was clear: every job matters.
items.passageZh: 每年公司都會頒獎給一位員工，表揚他優秀的服務。今年的評選很困難，因為很多人表現都很好。起初，團隊以為業務經理會得獎，結果獎項頒給了在這裡工作二十年的清潔人員呂先生。這個決定引起了一點爭論，因為這個獎過去一向頒給辦公室員工，從無例外。不過，總監解釋了她對「優秀服務」的理解：就是每天幫助別人。她向大家保證這個決定很公平。這件事的含意很清楚：每一份工作都很重要。

questions.questionZh: 一開始團隊以為誰會得獎？
這個決定傳達了什麼意思？
options: 清潔人員的薪水比經理高

items.promptZh: 除了星期日以外，這家店每天都營業。
referenceEn: The shop is open every day with the exception of Sunday.
With the exception of Sundays, this store is open every day.
rubricZh: exception 表示「例外」，例如 with the exception of…（除了…之外）等
寫 except Sunday 意思也對；「營業」可寫，例如 is open 等

items.promptZh: 這份預算是建立在銷售量會成長的假設上。
referenceEn: This budget is based on the assumption that sales will grow.
The budget was based on the assumption that sales would increase.
rubricZh: assumption 常用 the assumption that…（例如 based on the assumption that… 等）
「建立在…上」可寫，例如 is based on 等；時態可用現在式或過去式，子句配合
「成長」可寫，例如 grow、increase、go up 等
